issue.description:
Plan: docs/plan/plan.md Phase 3a. Independent.

## Task
- src/workflows.py: `normalize_failure(message)` strips hex hashes, UUIDs, ISO timestamps, durations,
  pod/node names, absolute paths and numbers > 3 digits, lowercases, collapses whitespace, and returns
  (normalized_text, sha256[:12]).
- `failure_class` from a small reviewed rule table (`failure_classes.yaml`, ordered regexes):
  timeout, oom, clone_auth, image_pull, test_failure, lint, build, infrastructure, unknown.
- src/parquet_io.py: additive nullable columns `failure_fingerprint`, `failure_class`; schema
  conformance fills null for rows written by older releases.
- docs/notes/output-schema.md updated; tests with at least 12 real-looking messages covering every class.

## Acceptance
- Two messages differing only in ids/timestamps share a fingerprint; messages of different classes do not.
- Existing consumers (dashboard-site argo panel) unaffected; VERSION bumped.
issue.title: Add failure_fingerprint and failure_class columns to runs.parquet (Phase 3a)
